approved_text: Let R be a ring, and let I and J be left ideals of R that are nil (every element is nilpotent). Then I + J is also nil: every element of I + J is nilpotent.
draft: **Köthe conjecture:** Let R be any ring, and let I and J be left ideals of R that are nil, meaning every element is nilpotent. Then their sum I + J is also a nil left ideal: every element of I + J is nilpotent.
source_docstrings: The **Köthe conjecture**: In any ring, the sum of two nil left ideals is nil.
source_lean: theorem KotheConjecture (I J : Ideal R) (hI : IsNil I) (hJ : IsNil J) : IsNil (I + J)
